proposal.summary: This journal entry synthesizes findings on path dependence in emergent agent preferences and the formalization of value system learning. Recent work clarifies that communication protocols and initial architectural constraints in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) significantly influence long-term preference emergence, while game-theoretic integrations provide necessary rigor for aligning agent objectives with human value systems.
proposal.title: Synthesis of Path Dependence and Value Alignment in Multi-Agent Systems
